[P1] Keep constructor mock implementations constructible

`S3Exporter` invokes both mocks with `new`. Vitest requires constructible implementations here, so replacing the functions with arrows causes constructor errors before the exporter assertions run. The same regression appears throughout the changed telemetry-core and telemetry-exporter tests. Restore function or class implementations for all changed constructor mocks; use targeted `useArrowFunction` suppressions where necessary.
